compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: When rollout:feature-flags-approved is present on the story or its parent epic (two-hop), task-decomposer emits a flag-guarded cutover task paired with a flag-removal cleanup task.
- dd-2: When the tag is absent on both (including no parent), no feature-flag task is emitted and the plan header records feature_flags:prohibited with a (non-empty) reason.
- dd-3: The presence of feature-flag wording in the story text does not by itself trigger a feature-flag task when the approval tag is absent.

## TDD Exemption
behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 (non-executable LLM instruction/contract artifacts): task-decomposer.md, SKILL.md, and feature-flags-marker.md are prose files; verification is task-3's structural-boundary suite (test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh), which goes RED when this prose is reverted. testing_mode GREEN.

## Implementation
1. plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md — fill the reserved flag-tag case in the migration-class/rollout dispatch point (established by sibling 1c2b; defensively add the reserved flag-tag header at the dispatch point if absent). The agent reads ONLY the passed-in {feature-flags-marker} (NEVER story prose; never the two-hop lookup — prohibited from ticket/shell access). APPROVED -> emit a flag-cutover task (reserved flag-cutover namespace) PAIRED WITH a flag-cleanup task (reserved flag-cleanup namespace) [dd-1]. PROHIBITED -> emit NO feature-flag task AND record feature_flags:prohibited in the plan header accompanied by the marker's reason (non-empty, not a bare token) [dd-2]. Emission keys off the resolved marker verdict, never prose -> feature-flag wording without the tag yields prohibited [dd-3].
2. plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md — Step 1: after migration-class detection, invoke resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh and persist a last-wins FEATURE_FLAGS: ticket comment (mirror MIGRATION_CLASS persistence ~lines 250-263). Step 3: pass the last FEATURE_FLAGS marker to the decomposer as a {feature-flags-marker} dispatch arg.
3. plugins/dso/docs/contracts/feature-flags-marker.md — NEW contract doc, parity with migration-class-marker.md (JSON shape, fields, source-of-truth helper, safe-default, consumer protocol); cross-reference from task-decomposer.md.
Keep additive/backward-compatible: stories without a FEATURE_FLAGS marker decompose as before.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] GREEN gate: task-3 structural suite now passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-task-decomposer-flag-case.sh 2>&1 | tail -1 | grep -qE 'FAILED: 0\b'
- [ ] dd-1: APPROVED branch emits flag-cutover PAIRED WITH flag-cleanup
  Verify: grep -qF 'flag-cutover' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qF 'flag-cleanup' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] dd-3: emission keys off the passed-in {feature-flags-marker}, never story prose
  Verify: grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qiE 'never .*(story prose|prose)|only the passed-in marker' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] dd-2: PROHIBITED branch records feature_flags:prohibited WITH the marker reason (non-empty), not a bare token
  Verify: grep -qF 'feature_flags:prohibited' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qiE 'feature_flags:prohibited.{0,80}reason|reason.{0,80}feature_flags:prohibited|with (the |its )?reason' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 1 invokes the helper and persists a last-wins FEATURE_FLAGS: comment
  Verify: grep -qF 'resolve-feature-flag-approval.sh' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md && grep -qF 'FEATURE_FLAGS:' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 3 passes {feature-flags-marker}
  Verify: grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md
- [ ] Contract doc exists and is cross-referenced
  Verify: test -f plugins/dso/docs/contracts/feature-flags-marker.md && grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker.md' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): task-decomposer is READ-ONLY (cannot read ticket comments) and carries its own embedded protocol (does NOT load SKILL.md sub-sections at dispatch). Wiring {feature-flags-marker} ONLY in SKILL.md prose means the agent never sees it. d666 MUST (a) add {feature-flags-marker} to the EXPLICIT Step 3 dispatch 'Pass the following as task arguments' bullet list in SKILL.md, AND (b) add a matching input section (e.g. '### Feature-Flags Marker') in plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md '## Inputs' parallel to {testing-mode}. Verify: grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qF 'feature-flags-marker' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, HIGH): MIGRATION_CLASS and FEATURE_FLAGS are INDEPENDENT markers (separate ticket comments, separate Step 1 helpers). The flag-tag case MUST be an independent conditional that does NOT gate on, reset, or short-circuit the migration-class case — a story that is both migration-class:db AND feature-flags approved must emit BOTH the rollback pair AND the flag pair. The dispatch point evaluates the two markers as separate conditionals, not a mutually-exclusive switch. Verify: grep -qiE 'independent|in addition to|separately|does not (gate|short-circuit)' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, MED): the emitted flag pair must carry the ordering edge at emission time — the flag-cleanup task is emitted with depends_on referencing the flag-cutover task's temp_id (cleanup only safe AFTER cutover). Two-pass ordering (982a) CONSUMES depends_on edges, it does not create them; without the edge cleanup could run before cutover. Mirror the sweep pair's manual-verification depends_on automated-sweep. Document the ordering invariant in feature-flags-marker.md. Verify: grep -qiE 'flag-cleanup.{0,120}depends_on|depends_on.{0,120}flag-cutover|cleanup.{0,80}after.{0,80}cutover' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
comments.author: Test

comments.body: AC amendment (gap analysis from 982a, CRITICAL): The feature-flag pair emission must make the emitted tasks carry a reserved tag migration-role:flag-cutover / migration-role:flag-cleanup so the sprint two-pass consumer (982a) can pair halves deterministically. Specify in the flag-tag case prose. Verify: grep -qiE 'migration-role' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
